subject: Request: 15-min technical triage before full demo - NovaCart
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom@novacart.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick 15-min tech triage before demo

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after our sign-up. Before we schedule a full product demo with the team, could we do a 15-minute technical triage to confirm a few integration points? High-level items we want to cover:
- SSO (SAML / Okta) compatibility
- Data residency and retention options for dedicated deployments
- Any client-side network changes (eg. firewall rules, egress) required for Private deployment

We're a small infra team; a focused 15-minute call would help us decide whether to move forward with a full demo and procurement. I can be available tomorrow morning (noon or earlier PT) or Monday after 10am PT.

Attaching a brief infra overview so you have context.

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Head of Platform, NovaCart
Tom.Reyes@novacart.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: novacart-infra-overview.docx (document stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Tom Reyes <tom@novacart.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before demo

Hi Tom — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the infra doc. I'm copying Priyom (solutions engineer) and Marissa (AE) so we have the right folks on deck for the triage.

We can do a short 15-minute technical check. Available slots tomorrow (Mon) morning PT:
- Mon 2026-11-09 09:00–09:15 PT
- Mon 2026-11-09 10:00–10:15 PT
- Mon 2026-11-09 11:30–11:45 PT

If those don't work, tell me a preferred window and we'll try to accommodate. For the triage we typically cover:
- SSO setup specifics (IdP metadata, just-in-time provisioning requirements)
- Where models and logs will be hosted and retained for Dedicated/Private
- Any IP allowlist or reverse-proxy considerations

I've attached our 1-page triage checklist to speed the call. If there are specific docs/diagrams beyond the infra overview, feel free to send them. I'll send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
SDR, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-triage-checklist.pdf (document stub)

From: Tom Reyes <tom@novacart.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before demo

Kimberly — thanks, 10:00–10:15 PT on Monday works best for us.

A couple of quick notes to scope the triage so we stay within 15 minutes:
- Primary ask: confirm SSO flow with Okta (we use SCIM as well)
- Secondary: whether logs and token cache ever persist outside of customer VPC for Private deployment
- We might share a short network diagram during the call (small PNG) — attaching now.

See you Monday at 10.

Tom

Attachment: novacart-network-diagram.png (image stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Tom Reyes <tom@novacart.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before demo

Perfect — we're confirmed for Mon 2026-11-09 10:00–10:15 PT. Calendar invite attached (ics).

Agenda (15 min):
1) Quick intros (1 min)
2) SSO + SCIM quick check (6 min) — Priyom will cover requirements and what we need from your IdP
3) Deployment/data residency and logs (4 min)
4) Next steps & full demo scheduling (4 min)

If you want to include any additional attendees on your side, please add them to the invite. For the follow-up demo we can bring in Product and Security if desired. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/NC-47

See you shortly — Kim
